digest.component_or_area: LLM model capabilities and sampling parameter handling
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table contains only one entry (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) but claude-opus-4-8, rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL, rejects temperature requests (HTTP 400) and is not listed, leaving the default model unguarded.

Both us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 and global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 models reject temperature and top_p parameters with ValidationException, but only the us variant was initially added to overrides, and the global variant remains uncovered by any literal table entry.

The direct Anthropic adapter (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings while Bedrock adapter (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) returns HTTP 400, masking a defect that affects both provider paths identically.

Code-review Pass-2 pins temperature=0 for determinism on claude-opus-4-8, but since the model rejects non-default temperature values, the parameter is ignored and greedy decoding is not actually enforced in production.

Temperature=1.0 (the API default) succeeds on opus-4-8 while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating the rejection is of parameter tunability rather than parameter presence, so supports_temperature field naming correctly captures the mechanism.
